reason: I grab my Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way, and I'm not ordering cans online or going looking for some bistro that stocks it. It also costs more than what I already drink, so it doesn't fit my routine.
objection: Where can I actually buy it? If it's not in the fridge at Albert, Tesco or the petrol station I pass every day, it doesn't exist for me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the chilled section at Albert or Tesco next to the energy drinks, ideally at around 45 CZK, so I could try one without going out of my way.
